expansion_contract.fact_row: verified official-source, canonical-state, workflow-evidence or acceptance-contract fact
expansion_contract.boundary_row: prevents historical premise-base counts, address matching, aggregate provider records, business datasets or FWA modelling from being promoted to exact January 2026 postcode or parcel coverage without accepted r2 bytes and hardened postjoin evidence

source_routes.name: Methodology Annex premise-base and matching screenshots

facts.detail: The terminal heartbeat has no active owner lease.
No active or over-15-minute PENDING execution exists.

guard_streams.write_limit: No second task, owner takeover or parallel runner is permitted.

facts.detail: The exact 11,013-row output JSONL remains empty.
The source snapshot remains exact_rows_returned zero and source_scan_complete remains false.

guard_streams.write_limit: No candidate or 3/4 promotion before exact r2 and hardened postjoin acceptance.

facts.detail: The premise base uses AddressBase property information combining postal addresses with additional local-authority property detail.
AddressBase Premium and Islands provide the base dataset for residential and commercial coverage assessment.

guard_streams.write_limit: A methodology premise base does not establish an exact Spring 2026 parcel metric.

facts.detail: Sub-properties within buildings are considered independently of the number of postal delivery points.
Each Basic Land and Property Unit has a UPRN, spatial reference and one or more Land and Property Identifiers.

guard_streams.write_limit: A UPRN or sub-property definition alone is not coverage evidence.

facts.detail: A service-delivery address must be able to receive mail directly or indirectly through a related address.
The address must not itself be a parent shell and may have a parent only when that parent is a parent shell.

guard_streams.write_limit: Service-delivery eligibility is a premise-base rule, not proof that broadband is available.

facts.detail: Premise construction retains addressable postal-object statuses D, C or L.
Only approved addresses with an in-use BLPU state are retained.

guard_streams.write_limit: Filtering rules cannot be applied speculatively to the parcel table without the exact source data.

facts.detail: Records require an NSPL postcode inside the Ordnance Survey land boundary and England, Northern Ireland, Scotland or Wales.
Included classifications cover commercial, residential, dual-use and specified service-delivery object categories.

guard_streams.write_limit: Geographic or class inclusion does not establish an Ofcom coverage row.

facts.detail: CN2025 received more than 124 million fixed-broadband availability records at individual premises.
Almost all uniquely identified premises, 99.7 percent, matched at least one provider using a UPRN or building-address reference.

guard_streams.write_limit: Historical national matching rates cannot be assigned to an individual Spring 2026 postcode.

facts.detail: Matching uses direct UPRN-hierarchy matches and confident building-number or name, street and postcode matches.
Approximate matching may use a street address and postcode when a fuller building identifier is unavailable.

guard_streams.write_limit: Approximate address matching is not equivalent to exact postcode coverage acceptance.

facts.detail: 31.4 million premises, 97.1 percent, were matched to provider records using the UPRN.
Just over 7,000 premises were matched using address information only.

guard_streams.write_limit: National match outcomes do not identify which current task rows have exact r2 coverage.

facts.detail: Nearly 10,000 initially unmatched premises were subsequently linked through the UPRN parent-child relationship.
Just over 81,000 premises remained without a confident match in the July 2025 premise base.

guard_streams.write_limit: An unmatched historical premise must not be labelled as zero coverage.

facts.detail: 184,000 provider records matched only to a postcode and were excluded from the address-level analysis.
9,000 provider records could not be assigned to any geographic location and were excluded.

guard_streams.write_limit: Excluded records cannot be recycled into postcode proxies.

facts.detail: Ofcom did not use postcode-based estimates for the unused provider records in order to preserve address-level accuracy.
Fixed providers were asked to report premises where an end-user could order service, together with technologies and predicted speeds.

guard_streams.write_limit: Orderability must be read from the exact current archive, not inferred from methodology.

facts.detail: Full-fibre availability requires fibre close enough that only a dedicated premises connection remains and at most a published pre-agreed charge.
Available broadband speed is calculated from the maximum predicted download speed among providers covering the premises.

guard_streams.write_limit: Historical definitions cannot replace the January 2026 r2 metric values.

guard_streams.source: CN2025 Methodology Annex and canonical workflow evidence

facts.detail: Business coverage products exclude dedicated leased lines, while FWA provider data is matched against the same premise base as fixed broadband coverage.
The available current-HEAD search returned zero PR-triggered runs; the same task retained zero candidate, measured-speed or accuracy promotions.

guard_streams.write_limit: Business connectivity and modelled FWA cannot substitute for exact all-premises r2 postcode acceptance.
